City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 24, 2016
07:00
P.M.
6:00 P.M. SPECIAL BUDGET STUDY SESSION
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway and Solis
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54954.3(a), you may only address the City Council concerning any item that has been described in the notice for the special meeting. Please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speakerâ€™s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
NEW BUSINESS
No action may be taken on a Study Session item other than direction to staff to further review or prepare a report. Any proposed action regarding Study Session items must be agendized for a future Regular or Special City Council meeting.
SS-1
STUDY SESSION: PRESENTATION, DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2016/2017 RECOMMENDED BUDGET
It is recommended that the City Council review and discuss the Fiscal Year 2016/2017 Recommended Budget.
Notice and Call 5-24-16
SS-1 FY 16-17 Recommended Budget
7:00 P.M. REGULAR SESSION
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificates of Recognition to the 2016 Puente Pride Spring Award Winners
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF MAY 10, 2016.
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of May 10, 2016.
A-1 Minutes 5-10-16 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
UPDATE AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE CITY OF LA PUENTEâ€™S STRATEGIC PLAN
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 Strategic Plan Quarterly Update Staff Report
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1404
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5274 approving Warrant Register No. 1407.
D-1 Warrents Resolution #1407
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF REAPPOINTMENT OF CITY MANAGER TO CIVIC RECREATIONAL INDUSTRIAL AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council reappoint City Manager Carmany to the Civic-Recreational Industrial Authority (CRIA) Board.
D-2 CRIA Appointment Staff Report
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A LIABILITY AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR THE COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION EVENT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Countywide Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting Liability Agreement; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
D-3 Hazardous Waste Collection Staff Report
D-3 Hazardous Waste Collection Attachment A Agreement
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF COMPLETED SUBDIVISION AGREEMENT - TRACT MAP NO. 72941 - 527 LEAGUE AVENUE, LA PUENTE, LUIS & MARIBEL BOBADILLA (Developer)
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) accept the Subdivision Agreement off-site improvements as completed; and (2) authorize the City Clerk to execute the Notice of Completion.
D-4 Tract Map 72941 NOC Staff Report
D-4 Tract Map 72941 NOC Attachment A Agreement
D-4 Tract Map 72941 NOC Attachment B NOC
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A PARK USE AGREEMENT WITH THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY INC. FOR THE 2016 RELAY FOR LIFE OF LA PUENTE EVENT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Park Use Agreement for the 2016 Relay for Life of La Puente event; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-5 Relay for Life Staff Report
D-5 Relay for Life Attachment A Agreement
D-6
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF THE FISCAL YEAR 2016-2017 RECOMMENDED BUDGET AND RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE CITYâ€™S ANNUAL BUDGET IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE ADOPTION OF THE CITYâ€™S GANN APPROPRIATION LIMIT AND ESTABLISHING CONTROLS ON CHANGES IN APPROPRIATIONS FOR THE VARIOUS FUNDS
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) Approve the FY 16-17 Recommended Budget effective July 1, 2016; (2) Direct the City Manager to make any necessary changes to the recommended budget for incorporation into the final budget; (3) Approve carryover appropriations in the amount of $270,000.00 to upgrade the Cityâ€™s financial software system ($40,000.00), to complete a User Fee Study & Cost Allocation Plan ($30,000.00), and to complete the items on the Cityâ€™s deferred maintenance list ($200,000.00); and (4) Adopt Resolution No. 16-5275 adopting the Cityâ€™s Fiscal Year 2016-2017 annual budget in conjunction with the adoption of the Cityâ€™s GANN Appropriation Limit and establishing controls on changes in appropriations for the various funds.
D-6 FY 16-17 Recommended Budget Staff Report
D-6 FY 16-17 Recommended Budget Attachment A Budget
D-6 FY 16-17 Recommended Budget Attachment B Resolution
D-6 FY 16-17 Recommended Budget Attachment C Deferred Maintenance Items
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE ENTITIES PERMITTED TO SELL SAFE AND SANE FIREWORKS IN THE CITY AND THE APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR THE SALE OF FIREWORKS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5276 to designate the application process and approve the issuance of permits to the Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 1944 to sell Safe and Sane Fireworks pursuant to all applicable code requirements.
D-7 Fireworks Staff Report
D-7 Fireworks Attachment A Applications
D-7 Fireworks Attachment B Resolution
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF A RIGHT OF ENTRY AGREEMENT WITH THE CITY OF INDUSTRY FOR THE REPAINTING OF THE AZUSA AVENUE BRIDGE OVER VALLEY BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Right of Entry Agreement with the City of Industry; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
D-8 Bridge Right of Entry Staff Report
D-8 Bridge Right of Entry Attachment A Agreement
D-9
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR STREET AND PARKWAY/MEDIAN IMPROVEMENTS ALONG TEMPLE AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the plans and specifications for the Construction of Street Improvements on Temple Avenue; and (2) authorize staff to solicit bids.
D-9 Temple Avenue Street Improvements Staff Report
D-10
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER AND STREET USE AGREEMENT FOR THE LA PUENTE KIWANIS CLUBâ€™S FIRST ANNUAL CAR SHOW
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5277 approving a request for a fee waiver in the amount of $3,670.00 and approval of a Street UseAgreement with the La Puente Kiwanis Club for its first annual Car Show.
D-10 LP Kiwanis Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-10 LP Kiwanis Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-10 LP Kiwanis Fee Waiver Attachment B Agreement
D-10 LP Kiwanis Fee Waiver Attachment C Site Plan
D-11
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING FINDINGS AND DISPENSING WITH THE COMPETITIVE BIDDING PROCESS, AND APPROVING A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH HDL, COREN AND CONE FOR PROPERTY TAX CONSULTING & AUDITING SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $20,640
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 16-5278 making findings and dispensing with the competitive bidding process; and (2) approve the agreement with HdL, Coren and Cone, and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-11 HDL Property Tax Agreement Staff Report
D-11 HDL Property Tax Agreement Attachment A Agreement
D-11 HDL Property Tax Agreement Attachment B Resolution
D-12
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING FINDINGS TO DISPENSE WITH THE COMPETITIVE BIDDING PROCESS AND APPROVING THE PURCHASE OF COMPUTER SERVER, STORAGE, SOFTWARE AND PERIPHERALS IN THE AMOUNT OF $31,100
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 16-5279 making findings and dispensing with the competitive bidding process; and (2) authorize the purchase of the computer server, storage and peripherals per the attached Dell Marketing quote.
D-12 Dell Server Purchase Staff Report
D-12 Dell Server Purchase Attachment A Dell Quote
D-12 Dell Server Purchase Attachment B SHI Quote
D-12 Dell Server Purchase Attachment C Resolution
D-13
CONSIDERATION OF A CONFLICT WAIVER FOR CASSO & SPARKS, LLP FOR TWO LICENSE AGREEMENTS INVOLVING THE USE OF THE CITY OF INDUSTRY'S PARK & RIDE LOT
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Conflict Waiver for Casso & Sparks, LLP.
D-13 Park and Ride Conflict Waiver Staff Report
D-13 Park and Ride Conflict Waiver Attachment A Letter
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING PLANNING COMMISSIONER INTERVIEWS
It is recommended that the City Council provide staff with direction regarding Planning Commissioner applicant interviews.
E-1 Commission Appointments Staff Report
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this this 19th day of May, 2016
